final: WITH channel_rates AS (SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) AS rate FROM channel_rates) SELECT AVG(c.avg_fee_rate) AS mean_above_benchmark_rate, AVG(c.avg_fee_rate - b.rate) AS mean_excess FROM channel_rates AS c CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE c.avg_fee_rate > b.rate
